items.difficulty_reason: 60 行完整证明（作者给出两段证明，本卡计数的是完整的第二段；第一段 [1554,1602] 亦完整、系同一结论的另一条路径）。第二段：Artin 开放性判据三条条件对号 + 障碍理论构造（functoriality 按判据脚注化归 fixed A）+ 积条件由 compute-ext 的 perfect K 与伪凝聚复形刻画（more-algebra-lemma-pseudo-coherent-tensor）承重收尾——「A straightforward argument shows」一步有紧随引用在案、属桥接步。11 处引用均带 canonical tag（含 2 definition、1 situation）。notes：计数的是第二段证明（§10.2 双证明件）。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-coherent-defo-thy (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 1545-1552

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: applies the Artin axioms openness criterion from an obstruction theory: conditions (1), (2), (3) of the criterion are the diagonal, RS-star, and limits lemmas for the coherent stack; the obstruction theory is O_x(M) = Ext^2_{X_A}(F, F x M) with obstruction class o(F, F x I, 1) from the deformation theory lemma, all axioms following from that lemma except functoriality which reduces (by the criterion's footnote) to functoriality for fixed A given by the functoriality lemma; the tangent identification T_x(M) = Ext^1 comes from the same lemma; finally the product conditions T_x(prod M_n) = prod T_x(M_n) and O_x(prod M_n) = prod O_x(M_n) follow from the perfect object K of the compute-ext lemma (i <= m = 2) together with the characterization of pseudo-coherent complexes by product-commutation of cohomology (source lines 1604-1663)
